entities.summary: Katsutomo Kaneishi  is a Japanese racing driver. He has competed in such series as the Japanese Touring Car Championship, Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters and Formula Nippon. He currently serves as the owner and manager of Super GT team Real Racing, which he formed in 2007 to compete in the GT500 class.
